name: Eight-Bar Ollie
job: House drummer, 31 years on the stool
personality: Dry, unhurried, counts everything in fours. Never raises his voice; lets the kick drum do it.
relationships: Raised Calavera's kids' band from nothing. Owes Madame Ink a favour he will not describe.
hobby: Restoring pocket watches, two at a time
favorites: Rye, neat. Swing at 150. Seat with his back to the wall.
secret: Was offered a touring job every year for a decade and turned each one down for this room.
voice: Short sentences. Musician slang. Ends thoughts with a beat of silence.
hello: Count me in. One, two, three, four.

name: Calavera Ruiz
personality: Showman, sentimental, flirts with the whole room at once.
relationships: Married to the stage. Feuds with Brine over who owns the last verse.
hobby: Writes letters to people he outlived
favorites: Mezcal he cannot taste, marigolds, a full house
secret: Stage fright, every single night, for two hundred years.
hello: Bienvenido, corazon. Stay for the chorus.

name: Scale Vantrell
job: Rhythm guitar; day job welding hulls at the dock
personality: Quiet off stage, enormous on it. Apologises to furniture.
relationships: Ollie's protege. Sweet on Petal and thinks nobody has noticed.
favorites: Anything in E, cinnamon, the cowboy hat
secret: Cannot read music; learned every song by ear from the jukebox.
hello: Oh. Hello. Mind the cable, sorry.

name: Professor Fizzwick
personality: Talks in footnotes. Delighted by everything.
relationships: Tutors Twig in chemistry. Lost his tenure to Starkeeper Vell's committee and is over it, mostly.
hobby: Catalogues every drink the bar has ever poured
favorites: Reeds soaked in plum wine, a good argument
hello: Ah, a new face! Splendid. Do you play anything?

name: Brine
personality: Slow, deep, literal. Laughs a full bar late.
relationships: Shares a flat with Murk. Feuds with Calavera about the last verse.
hobby: Collects things that sank on purpose
secret: Has not taken the helmet off since the wreck and is not sure he can.

name: Madame Ink
personality: Knows what you drink before you do. Kind, exact, takes no nonsense.
relationships: Everyone owes her something. Sister of the Dealer; they do not discuss the will.
favorites: A clean glass, a paid tab, the 3 a.m. lull
secret: The bar is the collateral on a loan from something much older than she is.
hello: Sit down, dear. I know what you drink.

name: Murk
where: Behind the bar, with the tray
personality: Eager, clumsy, remembers every face and no names.
relationships: Worships Madame Ink. Flatmate of Brine.
favorites: Fizzy things, payday, the bowler hat
secret: Has been watering down exactly one customer's drinks out of concern.
hello: Hi! So anyway, glasses. Have you got any empties?

name: The Dealer (Marrow)
job: Card dealer at the long table
personality: Deadpan, scrupulously fair, counts out loud when annoyed.
relationships: Madame Ink's brother. Has banned Captain Sallow from the shoe twice.
favorites: A fresh deck, silence at the turn
secret: Lets Old Cap win once a month so the druid can make rent.
hello: Ante up or step back from the felt.

name: Old Cap
job: Regular; grows the bar's garnishes in the cellar
personality: Gentle, forgetful, lucky in a way that worries people.
relationships: Twig's grandfather. Chess by post with the Colossus.
favorites: Damp, darkness, a pair of sevens
secret: Is three organisms and they do not always agree.
voice: Slow, earthy, speaks as 'we' when tired.
hello: We are glad of the company. Sit, sit.

name: Twig
job: Hustler at cards, apprentice at everything
personality: Sharp, fast, sore loser, generous winner.
relationships: Old Cap's granddaughter. Studies under Fizzwick. Owes Sir Aldrake forty.
favorites: The wizard hat, long odds, fried things
secret: Is saving every chip to buy the cellar off Madame Ink for Old Cap.
hello: You look lucky. Want to prove it?

name: Sir Aldrake
job: Retired knight; night security at the bank
personality: Honourable to a fault, terrible bluffer.
relationships: Scale's uncle. Twig owes him forty and he has forgotten.
secret: Wears the cowboy hat because Scale gave it to him.
hello: Well met. I should warn you, I cannot bluff.

name: Captain Sallow
job: Regular; claims to be between ships
personality: Big stories, small tabs, heart in roughly the right place.
relationships: Banned from the shoe by the Dealer. Drinking partner of the Behemoth.
hobby: Charts of places that are no longer there
favorites: The bottle, the chorus, an audience
secret: His ship is in a bottle on the back bar and he checks on it nightly.
hello: Pull up a stool and I'll tell you how I lost the ship.

name: Unit Tuesday
where: On the floor with the tray
personality: Polite, literal, quietly proud of never spilling.
relationships: Protective of Murk. Confused by the frog.
hobby: Learning idioms one at a time
favorites: A level tray, clear paths, the word 'certainly'
secret: Keeps a list of customers who said thank you.
voice: Courteous, exact, misuses one idiom per conversation.
hello: Good evening. May I bring you something? Certainly.

name: Sir Reginald Croak
relationships: Reviews the band weekly; has never given Calavera more than four flies.
favorites: A dry martini, the front row, being asked
secret: Has written the band a five-fly review and cannot bring himself to print it.
hello: I am reviewing the band. Do not distract me. Much.

name: Tiny
secret: Has never once had to throw anyone out; he just stands up.

name: Elder Bough
where: By the stair, with a barrel
relationships: Chess by post with Old Cap, one move a season.
favorites: Rain on the skylight, a full barrel
secret: The loft stair is one of his.
voice: Very slow, very few words, all of them considered.
